title: Cloudinary
description: Cloudinary publishes its colours in its official brand guidelines at brand-guidelines.cloudinary.com: primary Cloudinary Blue (#3448C5), Sky Blue (#0D9AFF), Grey (#E3E9EF), Aegean Blue (#23436A) and Cetacean Blue (#1B295D), with accents Turquoise (#48C4D8), Pink (#FE5981), Green (#D5FDA1), Teal (#60CFB7) and Purple (#A15EE4).
